patterns: APPSC asks single-fact items: CR = Critically Endangered (not 'critically extinct'), IUCN list = Red List, IUCN HQ Gland, worst aquatic weed = water hyacinth.

Cause questions recur across PSCs: habitat destruction is the main cause; 'which is NOT a threat' with distractors like vegetarianism or loss of appetite; deforestation driven by agriculture and urban expansion.
Species-status sets (endangered groups, Indian wild ass habitat, Gooty tarantula, Red Sanders endemic to AP) appear with an AP flavour.
App MCQs are mostly multi-statement UPSC-style and lean on 2025-26 news (Phoenix project, Ujani, Raimona, discovery counts) that PYQs never test.
Many filed PYQs here are general biology/zoology one-liners (dinosaurs, bats, seahorse) that belong to other topics.
